entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I'm calling about an order. I... I think I need to make a return, but I'm just so confused by the website.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could you tell me a bit more about the item? What specifically is the issue?

It's a helmet I bought a while ago. The whole process is just so overwhelming. I thought the color would be different, and then I got worried about the safety features... I'm not sure. It's all still in the box, the box is unopened. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can help. It sounds like the helmet just wasn't what you were expecting. I just need to look up your order to check the return eligibility. Do you have your order number handy?
Oh, um, yes, I think so. Let me see... It's VF8675309.
Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... VF8675309. Okay, I see the order for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet. It looks like it was delivered 83 days ago.
Is that bad? I told you I was confused about the policy. I saw something online but I couldn't make sense of it.
Not at all. According to our policy for standard items, you have 90 days to make a return. Since you're at 83 days, you are well within the window for a full refund.
Oh! Really? That's... that's such a relief. So I can send it back?

Absolutely. I've just initiated the return for you. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file right now. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the item, we'll process your refund.
Wow. Thank you so much, Charlie. You've made this so much easier.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
